name: Chips Cheese and Gravy
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Preheat the oven to 220°C and spread the chips onto an oiled baking tray.
Bake the chips for around 15–20 minutes until they are slightly golden.
After about 5 minutes add grated cheese on top of the chips and continue cooking.
In a small saucepan melt in the butter and flour and mix continuously.
Cook on a low heat and slowly add the beef broth and black pepper. Stir continually.
When the chips are ready, divide between plates and add the gravy as desired.
